folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B321: whole audit, actual mechanisms and evidence limits
folds.body:
The full363-line audit was content-reviewed: CAE-A1–A18, F1–F8, all27 work comparisons and seven inferred patterns, P0–P8, fifteen K cards, E1–E8, N1–N5 and L1–L5. Preserve the original model, source labels and breakpoints as research proposals. The title's completed audit describes that bounded research task, not a delivered conceptual-ability system. Its October27 source locators and no-runtime-found claims are not refreshed by this review.

PartB is primarily secondary/wiki/snippet evidence, with explicit unfetched/unread questions. An S label means its cited source claim, not a primary scene or game execution. The statement that MTG is fully checkable cannot be read as full-rule verification: the report explicitly leaves parts of613 and dependencies unread. Doctor Who recollection, a historical catalogue example and a game-name hit do not establish the corresponding fictional/game mechanic. The brief's Hollow Knight erasure example is already corrected here. Sparse selected examples do not establish residue as a universal norm, all retroactivity as expensive, or any particular complete-erasure ceiling.

AD38 permits the actual supported mechanism, including genuinely complete traceless erasure, direct permanence, effortless effects or broad powers. Residue, a rememberer, resistance and heavy cost are illustrative dials, not taxes every world must pay. Body, referent, public name, physical ink, observer memory, relation, legal claim and a cause's consequences may change separately. The defined operation can reach several channels. Audience of a perceived effect and scope of a world mutation are not the same field in every case. World truth is not independently replaced for each viewer; an ordinary rule's truth facts need not all become observer-filtered merely to add a knowledge query.

A stable subject/reference plus scoped display is useful, but every historical prose record need not be rewritten to use today's name. A dated document may intentionally retain its author's then-known spelling and claim. A new tokenized representation still needs source, date, observer and selected effect semantics. Unknown label fallback can make a view robust; it does not validate a dangling authoritative ID or make corrupt state safe to import. A sealed residue ID/status can itself leak unknown existence. A missing name should not silently merge identities, create a second bestiary kind or grant information to observers who never knew the record existed.

Deleting one delta can remove a pure view mask, but it does not necessarily reverse spent costs, later behavior, transferred goods, political decisions, learned facts or body changes caused meanwhile. Undoing a base-derived death is already identified as a different operation in K9. An unchanged seeded base plus a copied log is sufficient only when exact versioned inputs, dependency history and the operation's selected restore scope are actually retained. Branching is one possible response to retroactive history, not a compulsory new-world-line implementation for every source. Strong same-history rewrite can be represented when its actual law requires it.

P3's proposed layer order, union of masks and timestamp/dependency resolution need the selected causal semantics. A shuffle test proves the chosen ordering is deterministic, not that a mutual dependency has a valid resolution or that the rule matches a source. A touch-counter acts through actual range, target, source and ongoing support, not by indiscriminately removing every tagged supernatural delta. Luck need not universally mean only changing a threshold; actual reroll, distribution, foresight, fortune transfer or outcome control have different supported laws and RNG/provenance contracts. Stable generation and independent chance streams are implementation tools, not restrictions on source-supported powers.

K cards are explicitly original framing. Their social/magical, irreversible/reversible and source-qualified/invented distinctions still matter: a forgiven debt needs its actual creditor/institution or causal fate effect; calling a custom a mechanism does not supply missing enforcement. An honorific call is an actual supported recitation/address event, not every occurrence of a string in reports or UI. HP charm/keeper/trigger costs, residue and death consequences here are not certified canon formulas. The K13 once-only cost is transaction settlement identity, not a permanent single-use limit. A folded route does not automatically move cargo or reset clocks.

P6's unknown-delta-kept-as-inert import proposal is unsafe to assume for a consequential effect: silently ignoring an unfamiliar seal or erasure can change actual eligibility or reveal hidden truth. Use the current compatibility owner and an explicit selected failure/refusal/recovery policy; optional-field shape alone is not old-save safety. Frozen-world remote casts do not always queue by default, and knowledge retention across every rewind is not universal. Each operation's clock, cross-world reach, carrier and affected state determine what changes and when. A remembered scene, a running deadline and an expired effect require distinct facts.

P8's origin/key model needs exact namespace/world/instance/version identity and recoverable base, not just a convenient kind:key label. Unseen but causally used facts may already be committed. An entity can need retained truth without being renamed, recruited or transformed, and keyed revisits do not freely instantiate a double. The proposed static architecture check is an enforcement idea with scope/false-positive questions, not an existing universal gate. Current AD51 supports a first useful selected seam; no project-wide refactor, all-generator migration, all-world channel registry or all-fifteen-card implementation is required before a bounded conceptual ability. No test, source fetch, primary scene, private artifact, save, RNG, reference consumer or runtime was changed by this review.
